slices.focus: Payment lag moves down; Kelli shifts from email coaching to in-person site visits with printed claim examples.
slices.summary: With payment lag finally moving in the right direction, Kelli shifts from email coaching to driving out to the two clinics creating most authorization and registration rework. She brings printed claim examples with highlighted bad fields, making the problems undeniable in person. She discovers two failure modes (speed-driven registration skips and interpretation-driven auth note errors) and plans a one-page visit summary and targeted cheat sheets.
